# F258 A1 deployed: measured improvement and comparison limits

#310 is deployed at fb565c165d74a3715ac5c24f477fa5496bef7e4b. The performance AFTER receipt on pr:310 records PID 31125, same-identity samples at 06:10:13/06:11:13/06:12:13 UTC on November 21, 2026: 158 inbox completions over 120.045989 s, 3.769 ms active/completion, 15.836% of one core, zero exact daemon launch deltas, and RSS 134336 -> 118624 KiB. Historical BEFORE was 64.927 ms/completion and 24.988% core on PID 22838/653f90ef96.

The observed route reduction is 17.23x and CPU reduction 9.153 percentage points, not identical ratios. Record cumulative held_us as well as active_us: the mean held time changed from 30.254 s BEFORE to 54.999 s AFTER, exposing a request-mix difference a per-completion number alone hides. Cohort counts were 81/82 live Copilot seats, not the packet's approximate 76; health cohort counts are not waiter counts. BEFORE had more admits and sends, host load was unrecorded, and daemon ages differed. Do not turn the observed CPU difference into exclusive feature attribution.

Pass counters remain absent from ping; retain four idle passes/55 s and six recipient reads/20 s as source/CI bounds. Broadcast filtering executes inside HeldSpan, so route active_us does not account for that filter CPU. AFTER's concurrent event sample was 0.3333/s; it was not a measured subscriber poll or CPU share.

Machine spawn-rate was sampled separately from CPU: 369.0 processes/s under high load, versus historical 388.7/s. These unmatched machine windows do not establish a feature-specific launch change. The exact daemon counters were flat during both CPU windows.

The merge's delivered operation already ended performance/310 at 06:07:04.408 UTC. Preserve AFTER evidence before closure, but do not reassign an ended holding merely to release it again.

**magicWand:** a read-only cost-window command reporting route active/held deltas, actual cohort counts, load, process CPU/RSS and inner-pass/subscriber-receive counters together.

**difficulties:** the merged PR's second detached review worktree was pruned before measurement; canonical main was the surviving read-only operating surface. Startup was allowed to settle, but host load stayed elevated and later spiked above 100 during the separate machine sampler. The receipt preserves those limits instead of silently calling the host quiet.
